book.name: Sarenta halomang-halomang
book.title: Sarenta Halomang-Halomang Lahatala Ana por-alolang bot burang ening

content: Yakob ana Laban ehava mi
Angmuse Yakob ana angmi tahit lamal ved danangoa adang ila.

Ved nu adana, ana eng uuling se, jar eng nu ue dadi mi, aabang nu abung angu, ana ateing. Bot jar eng abung angu jumba-aib kumpul tue ue tia sehi, se jar angu ba nehe metma jumba-aib ang naung inang ini na angu ebele. Aarunge var halala eele nu nehe metma jar eng angu vengtering.

Base, jumba-aib ang naung kalo emangpi nehe terang ila jar eng angu abung iila se, terangvala ang naung ini var angu aoring metma jar eng angu eahalang, senge jar angu metma jumba-aib ang naung inang ini na. Seng angse, ini bot bale var angu metma jar eng angu vengtering.
Yakob ana terangvala ang naung iadangtaaning hula, “Kaku naung! Iing anga, taang mi ba hoa?” Angmuse terangvala ang naung ini Yakob ebalet hula, “Ning anga, Haran aabang enehe.”
Yakob ana bot iadangtaaning hula, “Nimaeela Laban angu, iini apang-ateing ka? Aing angu Nahor oal.” Angmuse terangvala ang naung ini hula, “Ni apang-ateing.”

Yakob ana bot taaning hula, “Ana ue aaung-aaung ee, niang? Terangvala ang naung ini Yakob ebalet hula, “Ana aaung-aaung. Aarunge eeng uuling, oal jangu Rahel ana ejumba-aib ang naung terang hoa senge hula, angami jar metma mainang ini na.”

Angmuse Yakob ana terangvala ang naung iat mateng hula, “Ved jedung balolu sehi. Anga bae ooras binanta kumpul jedung. Base, binanta ba kumpul angami tila angu, aaung ba iini jar metma mainang ini na. Seng angse, iini bale ing terang ila dadi mi, senge ini bot dadi adang.”

Aarunge terangvala ang naung ini Yakob ehur angu ebalet hula, “Terangvala ang naung ini bae binanta ang naung emangpi terang hoa angami jedung se, ni bae ening aulang niang. Ni malekang iading ini hoa angami senge, ni hama-hamat var angu aoring metma jar eng angu eahalang, bot jar angu metma binanta ang naung inang ini na.
Yakob ana jedung terangvala ang naung iat mateng sehi se, Rahel ana imang ejumba-aib ang naung terang hoa mana angumi. Se aing ba biasat binanta ang naung terang angu ebele.

Uanguveng Yakob ana uuling ateing se, Rahel ana ejumba-aib ang naung terang hoa muse, ana lamal va abung, bot var ba jar eng vengtering angu aoring. Sengmuse ana jar metma imaela Laban ebinanta ang naung inang ini na.
Angmuse Yakob ana Rahel amiku, bot baut etatabi.
Yakob ana Rahel at sarentat hula, “Kaku! Naing anga, iimang ekaku Ribka oal.” Angmuse Rahel ana bihit ila imang veng at sarenta.

Laban ana ekaku Ribka oal Yakob ehoja angu vengmeet aulang muse, ana bihit ila Yakob aing sambut. Uanguveng Laban ana Yakob aing harak muse, ana aing karavang, bot amiku, sengmuse ana at ehava mi ila. Angmuse Yakob ana elamal-etahi angu metma Laban veng at sarenta.
Laban ana Yakob at mateng hula, “Etatabit poleve anga, venu-dingnu!”
Yakob ana Lea bot Rahel oleve medit metma ejangu ening
Yakob ana Laban abung mihit eluung miuuru nu muse,
Laban ana at mateng hula, “Poleve anga teaaiiba, aarunge kalo aana karajang paraseng metma manenang se, na nea. Naba ba metma eeseva ening se, aana vengbanang.”
Laban angu oal jangu aaru. Ehalomang angu ene Lea, emiaaru angu ene Rahel.
Lea eng angu sibal.
Aarunge Rahel angu, etatabit mehena, bot eboa angu di etatabit aalus.
Yakob ana Rahel aing suka. Angu ebele ana Laban at hubait hula, “Na hula aabung karajang eluung mitung bititu, senge ooal jangu emiaaru, Rahel angu aana metma manenang.”
Angmuse Laban ana Yakob ehur angu ebalet hula, “Rahel angu na bae metma nehe aabeung enang niang. Lebe miaaung, na metma maeenang! Base, aana angami mihi, senge karajang metma menenang.”

Angmuse Yakob ana karajang eluung mitung bititu, senge hula Rahel aing medit metma ejangu ening. Aarunge Yakob ana etatabit Rahel aing suka base, eluung mitung bititu angu, ana rasa se emenghula ved aaeedeng kolang edadenang.
Mitung bititu muse, Yakob ana Laban at hubait hula, “Na karajang ejol mi tila. Aaung ba netenangeli angu metma manenang, senge na aing medit metma nejangu ening.”
Angmuse nehe ba mana angu mi ang naung, emangpi Laban ana iajali, sengmuse ana pesta ening.

Kua angu, Laban ana bae Rahel metma Yakob enang niang, aarunge ana Lea ba at ila metma Yakob enang. Angmuse Yakob ana Lea at tia. Bot Laban ana emalea jangu nu ene Silpa angu metma Lea enang, senge metma Lea emalea ening. Aarunge emikuaveng muse, Yakob ana ateing se, angu Lea! Angmuse Yakob ana Laban at hubait hula, “Naba ba aana ening metma nadana tila anga? Na aabung karajang nekira metma vengboar eluung mitung bititu, senge aana Rahel metma manenang! Etatalang ba aana naajajala angu?” Laban ana Yakob ehur angu ebalet hula, “Yakob! Ekang oomi alil ekang! Nihada angami angu eamulung se, nehe bae ening aulang niang. Ekaku ba mieele angu mehal medi jedung se, ekaku kiki angu bae eturat mehal medi niang. Base, noal anga epesta angu, aana melekang akanap mietang bititu hengi. Eningse Rahel angu di na metma maeenang aana medi, aarunge aana malekang karajang mitung bititu maveng metma manenang hengi.”
Yakob ana ening Laban ehur angu eamulung. Pesta mietang bititu metma Lea adana angu Yakob ana eamulung sengmuse, Laban ana oal Rahel benang di metma Yakob enang, senge ana medit metma ejangu ening.
Laban ana emalea jangu nu ene Bilha angu metma Rahel enang, senge metma Rahel emalea ening.
Angmuse Yakob ana Rahel di at tia. Yakob ana omi metma Rahel ejahit milebe, Lea mi ataang oa. Angmuse Yakob ana bot karajang eluung mitung btitu metma Laban enang.
Yakob oal naung
Lahatala Ana ateing se, Yakob ana bae omi metma Lea ejahi niang muse, Ana Lea evaal emana angu buka, base ana vaal vengajai, aarunge Rahel angu karboa, base ana bae vaal vengajai niang.
Lea atou veng muse, ana vaal mehal nu vengajai. Lea ana vaal angu ene maveng, Ruben (evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌeeng uuling, vaal aeꞌ),
se ana hula, “Nesusa angu LAHATALA Ana etatabit uuling ateing. Angu ebele, angase nemehal di hula eng metma neuuling.”

Lea bot atou veng muse, ana vaal mehal nu vengajai. Lea ana vaal angu ene maveng, Simon (evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌnehe vengmee tilaꞌ), se ana hula, “Nemehal ana bae eng metma neuuling niang angu, LAHATALA Ana vengmee tila. Angu ebele, Ana vaal nu taang metma manenang maveng.”
Angmuse Lea bot atou veng. Ana bot vaal mehal nu vengajai muse, ana vaal angu ene maveng, Lewi,
se ana hula, “Vaal anga na vengajai muse, neparkara angu sengila. Angase nemehal ana malekang nat aabetat aaung-hama, se vaal mehal tue na vengajait metma maenang iila angu ebele.”

Lea bot atou veng. Angmuse ana vaal mehal nu vengajai. Lea ana vaal angu ene maveng, Yahuda (evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌtajaningꞌ, se ana hula, “Angase na LAHATALA Aing tajaning!” Seng angmuse, Lea ana bae vaal veng niang iila.

footnotes.text: Ibrani ehur angami angu, bae emolo niang.
Ibrani ehur mi se, Ruben angu, evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌuuling, vaal aeꞌ. Bot hur nu evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌnesusa angu ana uuling ateing iilaꞌ angu, oleve hama.
ꞌLewiꞌ angu, evengbanang tarang se hula, ꞌtaing vengpartaꞌ, bot ꞌabung-abung aing karavangꞌ.
